nomen.name: Inspect Assistants
nomen.info: Find all type assistants known to be associated with a value of a specific type.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Data to inspect.

outputs.name: Type Assistant
outputs.info: True if a basic type assistant is found for this value.

outputs.name: Curve Assistant
outputs.info: True if a curve assistant is found for this value.

outputs.name: Surface Assistant
outputs.info: True if a surface assistant is found for this value.

nomen.name: Inspect Nullness
nomen.info: Determine whether items in a data tree have values or are nulls.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Data to inspect.

outputs.name: Nulls
outputs.info: Specifies whether the given values are null.

nomen.name: Inspect Serialisation
nomen.info: Determine whether data of a given type can be serialised and deserialised.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Data to inspect.

outputs.name: Serialisable
outputs.info: True if data of this type can be stored in and written from files.

outputs.name: Mechanism
outputs.info: The mechanism by which the data can be serialised.

outputs.name: IO Id
outputs.info: Specifies whether data of this type can be serialised by the Grasshopper 2 standard IO mechanism, and gives the ID of the type.

nomen.name: Inspect Data Type
nomen.info: Determine the exact types of existing data.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Data to inspect.

outputs.name: Type Name
outputs.info: The human-centric name of the data type. This may differ on different Grasshopper setups.

outputs.name: Full Name
outputs.info: The exact programmatic name of the data type.

outputs.name: Description
outputs.info: Description of actual value.

outputs.name: Known Type
outputs.info: Value indicating whether Grasshopper knows how to work with this data type.

nomen.name: Inspect Validity
nomen.info: Inspect the validity of data.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Data to inspect.

outputs.name: Validity
outputs.info: True if a value is valid. QQ

outputs.name: Reasons
outputs.info: A description of why the value is invalid.

nomen.name: Dispatch Meta Data
nomen.info: Dispatch items based on meta data compliance.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Data to dispatch.

inputs.name: Meta Rules
inputs.info: Meta data rules. All rules are applied to all items.

outputs.name: Positive
outputs.info: Data with meta data matching at least one of the patterns.

outputs.name: Negative
outputs.info: Data without meta data, or whose meta data does not match any of the patterns.

nomen.name: Explode Meta Data
nomen.info: Explode meta data into names and values.

inputs.name: Meta Data
inputs.info: Meta data to explode.

outputs.name: Name
outputs.info: Names of each meta data entry.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Values of each meta data entry.

nomen.name: Extract Meta Data
nomen.info: Extract the meta data value stored under the specified name and promote it to primary data.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Items with meta data to extract.

nomen.name: Filter Meta Data
nomen.info: Filter meta data by name.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Data to filter.

inputs.name: Name Patterns
inputs.info: Name patterns for filtering. All patterns are applied to all items.

outputs.name: Positive
outputs.info: Data with meta data that matches at least one of the patterns.

outputs.name: Negative
outputs.info: Data without meta data, or whose meta data does not match any of the patterns.

nomen.name: Harvest Meta Data
nomen.info: Copy all meta data and turn it into regular data.

inputs.name: Data
inputs.info: Items with meta data to harvest.

outputs.name: Meta Data
outputs.info: Meta data for each value in the input.

nomen.name: Meta Data Value
nomen.info: Find the value associated with a specific meta name.

inputs.name: Item
inputs.info: Item with associated meta data.

inputs.name: Meta Name
inputs.info: Name of the meta datum value to be searched for.

outputs.name: Meta Value
outputs.info: Value, if any, associated with the specified name.

nomen.name: Remove Meta Data
nomen.info: Remove meta data from a data item.

inputs.name: Item
inputs.info: Item to remove meta data from.

inputs.name: Name Pattern
inputs.info: Name pattern for removal.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with the matching meta data removed.

outputs.name: Count
outputs.info: Number of removed meta data values per item.

nomen.name: Siphon Meta Data
nomen.info: Copy meta data from one primary value to another.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Source of meta data transfer.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.info: Target of meta data transfer.

inputs.name: Overwrite
inputs.info: Specifies whether existing data is overwritten in case of naming conflicts.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with meta data from both the target and the source values.

outputs.name: Count
outputs.info: Number of meta data transferred from source.

nomen.name: Create Meta Data
nomen.info: Create meta data out of several uniquely named values.

inputs.name: Names
inputs.info: Meta data names. A name may only occur once per list.

inputs.name: Values
inputs.info: Meta data values, exactly one per name.

outputs.name: Meta Data
outputs.info: Meta data containing all named values.

nomen.name: Create Meta Datum
nomen.info: Create a meta datum out of a single named value.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.info: Meta data name.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Meta data value.

outputs.name: Meta Datum
outputs.info: Meta datum containing a single named value.

nomen.name: Meta From Inputs
nomen.info: Create a single piece of meta data by combining the names and values of all inputs.

outputs.name: Meta Data
outputs.info: Meta data containing all input values.

nomen.name: Assign Rhino.Colour
nomen.info: Assign the `Rhino.Colour` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the object colour of the shape once baked.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Colour
inputs.info: Colour to assign. Leave blank to remove existing bake colour meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Rhino.Colour' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Rhino.Layer
nomen.info: Assign the `Rhino.Layer` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the object layer into which the shape once baked.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.info: Layer to assign. Leave blank to remove existing bake layer meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Rhino.Layer' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Rhino.Name
nomen.info: Assign the `Rhino.Name` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the object name of the shape once baked.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.info: Name to assign. Leave blank to remove existing bake object name.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Rhino.Name' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Rhino.Section
nomen.info: Assign the section meta data of a value, which affect the hatch pattern drawn on clipping sections.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Hatch
inputs.info: Hatch pattern, or leave blank to remove existing section hatch meta data.

inputs.name: Scale
inputs.info: Hatch scale. This is only relevant when the hatch pattern is not inherited from either layer or section plane.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Hatch angle. This is only relevant when the hatch pattern is not inherited from either layer or section plane.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Rhino.SectionHatch' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Display.Anchor
nomen.info: Assign the `Display.Anchor` meta datum to a value, allowing vectors to be drawn as pointed line segments in the viewports.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to, only makes sense for vectors.

inputs.name: Anchor
inputs.info: Anchor position to assign. Leave blank to remove existing anchor meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Display.Anchor' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Display.Colour
nomen.info: Assign the `Display.Colour` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the colour in which the value is drawn in the viewports.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Colour
inputs.info: Constant colour to assign. Leave blank to remove existing constant colour meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Display.Colour' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Display.Dashes
nomen.info: Assign the `Display.Dashes` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the dash pattern when the shape is drawn in the viewports.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Dashes
inputs.info: Description of dash pattern to assign. Leave blank to remove existing point symbol meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Display.Dashes' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Display.Diffuse
nomen.info: Assign the `Display.Diffuse` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the surface colour when the shape is drawn in the viewports.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Colour
inputs.info: Diffuse colour to assign. Leave blank to remove existing diffuse colour meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Display.Diffuse' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Display.Size
nomen.info: Assign the `Display.Size` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the size of point symbols when the shape is drawn in the viewports.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Size
inputs.info: Size to assign. Leave blank to remove existing point size meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Display.Size' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Display.Symbol
nomen.info: Assign the `Display.Symbol` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the point symbol used when the shape is drawn in the viewports.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Symbol
inputs.info: Symbol to assign. Leave blank to remove existing point symbol meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Display.Radius' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Display.Stroke
nomen.info: Assign the `Display.Stroke` meta datum to a value, thus overriding the curve thickness when the shape is drawn in the viewports.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Stroke
inputs.info: Stroke width to assign. Leave blank to remove existing curve stroke meta data.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned `Display.Stroke` meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Meta Data
nomen.info: Assign meta data to regular data.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Meta data
inputs.info: Meta data to assign.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned meta data.

nomen.name: Assign Physics.Density
nomen.info: Assign the `Physics.Density` meta datum to a value.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Density
inputs.info: Density to assign, specified in grams/cm³.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Physics.Density' meta datum.

nomen.name: Assign Physics.Material
nomen.info: Assign the `Physics.Material` meta datum to a value.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value to assign meta data to.

inputs.name: Material
inputs.info: Material to assign.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned 'Physics.Material' meta datum.

nomen.name: Bulk Assign
nomen.info: Assign a collection of meta data values all at once. Note that each input is optional and can be hidden.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Optional value to assign meta data to.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value with assigned meta data.

outputs.name: Meta Data
outputs.info: Meta data instance containing all the specified input values.

nomen.name: Merge Meta Data
nomen.info: Merge two or more meta data collections.

outputs.name: Meta Data
outputs.info: Merged meta data.
